name: bera_company_access
purpose: Keeps a company user signed in (short-lived sign-in token, HttpOnly).

name: bera_company_refresh
purpose: Renews a company user's sign-in without asking for the password again (HttpOnly, sent only to its own address).

name: bera_admin_access
purpose: Keeps an admin signed in (short-lived sign-in token, HttpOnly).

name: bera_admin_refresh
purpose: Renews an admin's sign-in without asking for the password again (HttpOnly, sent only to its own address).

name: bera_csrf
purpose: Protects signed-in actions from forged requests; the page copies it into a request header.

name: bera-theme
purpose: Remembers the light or dark theme the visitor chose. Stays in the browser and is never sent to the server.

name: matrix-hidden-columns:<project id>
purpose: Remembers which requirement columns a person hid in a project's comparison matrix. Holds only requirement ids, stays in the browser and is never sent to the server.

name: public-chat-history
purpose: Keeps the visitor's chats on the public website chat for a few hours (default 2), so earlier chats can be reopened. Written only after the visitor sends a message. Stays in the browser and is never sent to the server as storage; only the chat being written is sent with each question.

name: bera-beta-feedback-day
purpose: Remembers the day a beta tester was last asked for feedback, so the form is offered once a day. Holds only a date, stays in the browser and is never sent to the server.

name: Cloudflare security cookie
purpose: Cloudflare may set its own security cookie when the site is behind it. Not set by our code.

name: Stripe hosted pages cookies
purpose: Stripe's hosted payment and billing pages set their own cookies on Stripe's own domain. Not set by our code.
